استجزن (form X)
# اِسْتَجَزْنَ (istajazna) /is.ta.d͡ʒaz.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَجَازَ (istajāza)
# اُسْتُجِزْنَ (ustujizna) /us.tu.d͡ʒiz.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَجَازَ (istajāza)
# اِسْتَجِزْنَ (istajizna) /is.ta.d͡ʒiz.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَجَازَ (istajāza)
